records.name: Viit
records.evidence_locations: Rajandi PDF176/printed178, Wido ~ Veit ~ Vitus entry (text layer); Mägiste 1936 PDF45 “Viido Wied.”.
records.facts_used: Viit belongs to the Wido, Veit and Vitus family. Wido comes from Germanic names beginning with Wid- such as Widukind, ‘child of the forest’, while Vitus was understood in late Latin as ‘willing, kindly’. records.evidence_locations: Rajandi PDF67/printed69, Guido entry (text layer).

The form Kuido came into use only recently and was given three times in 1963.
